entries.title: Alberta heads to polls to decide whether to hold vote on separation from Canada

entries.title: Funding shortages force World Food Programme to cut aid to Gaza

entries.title: Bangladesh says it was not informed of its citizens' execution by Saudi Arabia
entries.snippet: Saudi Arabia said it executed two Bangladeshis last week for committing an "indecent act" in a mosque.

entries.title: Possible wreckage of Amelia Earhart's plane likely to be trees, say researchers

entries.snippet: Videos showed gunmen firing shots at Shroff's car while it was moving slowly past a crowd.

entries.snippet: The Airbus jet landed safely in Bulgaria and all passengers and crew aboard were unharmed, officials said.

entries.title: Australian prime minister says lawmaker critically injured by car is 'no accident'
entries.snippet: A car hit an Australian federal independent lawmaker on Monday, critically injuring her in an apparent deliberate attack, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said. The driver was arrested.

entries.title: Morning news brief

entries.title: Michigan's Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed campaigns in GOP stronghold
entries.snippet: Michigan's Democratic U.S. Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed is campaigning in the GOP stronghold of Michigan's Upper Peninsula, an area that hasn't voted for a Democrat in Congress in over a decade.

entries.title: Solar power is changing agriculture in Pakistan, but some fear it could cause issues
entries.snippet: Solar power is transforming agriculture in Pakistan. But in a country already facing water scarcity and extreme weather, some fear their widespread use could cause problems.

entries.title: Alberta voters weigh future in Canada
entries.snippet: On Monday voters in the oil-rich Canadian province of Alberta are deciding whether to take the first step toward a future referendum on independence.

entries.title: Trump endorses embattled Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for reelection
entries.snippet: Trump said in a post on social media that Netanyahu "has been a Great Warrior Prime Minister, and an even greater Partner for Peace in combatting the Islamic Republic of Iran."

entries.title: Trump to close and renovate D.C. golf course, despite legal battle
entries.snippet: President Trump continues his efforts to remake Washington, D.C. He wants to turn an area used by the public into a world-class golf course.

entries.title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine got no early warning from partners as Russia hits the power grid again
entries.snippet: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is grappling with the implications of recent Washington moves benefiting Russian President Vladimir Putin, including waiving U.S. sanctions on Moscow and signing a deal to import Russian diesel.

entries.title: Australian lawmaker critically injured by car is 'no accident,' prime minister says

entries.title: Criminal networks threaten the Amazon. Indigenous leaders want the UN to act
entries.snippet: More than a dozen Indigenous representatives from Peru, Brazil, Colombia and Ecuador are participating in the Oct. 19-23 U.N. conference on transnational organized crime, known as COP13.

entries.title: Latino voters helped put Trump back in the White House. What's their next move?
entries.snippet: The path to a U.S. House majority runs through heavily Latino districts in states such as Arizona, Colorado and Texas, where Democrats are counting on disaffected Trump supporters to swing back their way.

entries.title: Rubio heads to Central Asia as some wonder if he's keeping the most pressing matters at a distance
entries.snippet: This tour is intended to promote U.S. economic and security ties with Central and South Asia. But it has only tangential links to the Trump administration's current main foreign policy dilemmas in the Middle East and with the Russia-Ukraine war.

entries.title: Egypt's top security body agrees to help Saudi Arabia defend itself against Houthi attacks
entries.snippet: The Houthis have repeatedly attacked airports and oil infrastructure across the kingdom with drones and missiles that can change direction during flight, posing a challenge to interceptors.

entries.title: Macron condemns those who 'sought to bring down the Republic' after rioting mars nationwide protests
entries.snippet: "Those who looted will have to pay back for the damage, and those who sought to bring down the Republic will be held accountable," Macron said in a televised address to the nation.

entries.title: Jackson doesn't regret telling Collins to 'shut up' after protester interrupted Maine Senate debate
entries.snippet: "She said that it was a Troy supporter. She accused me of setting that up. I had no idea who it was," Jackson said.

entries.title: Photographer attacked by settlers in the West Bank feels insulted by Netanyahu
entries.snippet: The attack on Heidi Levine and Palestinians during the sensitive olive harvest again highlights the rampant settler violence that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has blamed on a small number of troublemakers.

entries.title: Pope Leo tells faithful in St. Peter's Square he will gradually resume duties after cancer surgery
entries.snippet: "Now that this delicate phase is behind me, I will gradually resume my activities, always with God's help and your prayers," Leo said, his voice sounding strong four days after the lower lobe of his right lung was removed.

entries.title: Trump endorses embattled Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for reelection
entries.snippet: Israelis are set to vote Oct. 27, in the first national elections since Hamas attacked Israel on Oct. 7, 2023.

entries.title: Vance faces tough questions on Iran war, immigration and more in CBS town hall
entries.snippet: The string of sharp queries, some from voters who said they had supported him and President Donald Trump, previewed the rocky path Vance may face trying to answer for the administration's record if he runs for president himself in 2028.

entries.title: Carney says 4 service members killed and dozens injured in fire at Alberta military base
entries.snippet: Fire crews scrambled late Saturday as fierce winds whipped flames beyond Canadian Forces Base Wainwright and into the surrounding rural area.

entries.title: The Republican governor candidates walking back some of their abortion stances
entries.snippet: The candidates' retreat suggests that, even as reproductive rights fade from the national spotlight and polls show voters are far more likely to prioritize cost-of-living concerns, the political ramifications of pushing for new abortion restrictions remain substantial.

entries.title: Houthi strikes on Saudi Arabia show the Yemeni rebels' growing strength
entries.snippet: At various times over the last decade, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, the United States, Britain and Israel have carried out punishing air raids on the rebels — only to see them grow even stronger.

entries.title: Oregon father is the latest armed civilian to confront a gunman in a U.S. mass shooting
entries.snippet: The heroic "good guy with a gun" who can stop an attack even before law enforcement can arrive has long been a rallying cry by gun rights advocates, arguing that armed citizens can act as a first line of self-defense and public protection.

entries.title: America's politically divided Jewish community braces for Israel's elections
entries.snippet: Netanyahu's supporters, especially among Orthodox Jews, believe he's protecting a country they love as central to their identity. Many liberal and younger Jewish Americans believe his policies have harmed Israel's global standing.

entries.title: No Kings rallies across U.S. urge voters to cast ballots early ahead of midterms
entries.snippet: The hundreds of planned events were being billed as nonpartisan, though they sought to build on nearly two years' worth of No Kings marches and demonstrations by people upset with Trump's presidency.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: 'We don't have to wait for others to support us': Myanmar refugees find hope in Thailand's work program
entries.snippet: A year ago, Thailand granted long-staying refugees from Myanmar the right to work legally. Refugees and rights groups welcome the move but say the program's first year has exposed significant shortcomings.

entries.title: UN food program cuts aid to 500,000 Palestinians in Gaza
entries.snippet: Amid funding shortages, the World Food Program has said it is being forced to reduce necessary aid. Over two-thirds of Palestinians in Gaza are facing acute hunger, according to the agency.

entries.title: From delivery driver to global fame: A Korean writer's journey
entries.snippet: You Yeong-Gwang's The Rainfall Market tells the story of a mysterious, hidden shop that only opens when it rains. For a debut novel by an unknown author, it was a massive success.

entries.title: The homeless man living in front of a London mega-mansion
entries.snippet: Anders Fernstedt lives in London without any money. The Swedish native has built a most unusual home under the porch of a house worth over €200 million. How did that happen?

entries.title: Greece: At least 12 die in migrant drownings overnight
entries.snippet: Authorities say 12 people, including an infant, have drowned in Greek waters in two separate incidents overnight. Another 22 people were rescued. A search-and-rescue operation is ongoing.

entries.title: Australian MP seriously hurt in suspected car attack
entries.snippet: Helen Haines, an independent federal lawmaker, has been struck by a car in what Australia's prime minister has called an apparent attack.

entries.title: Ukraine got 'no warning' of Russian ballistic strikes, Zelenskyy says
entries.snippet: Massive strikes overnight hit the capital Kyiv, and damaged power stations, killing at least one person and cutting power to hundreds of thousands.

entries.title: West Bank: Israel arrests 10 suspects over settler attacks on US journalist, European diplomats
entries.snippet: Israeli police made the arrests following attacks on a US journalist and European diplomats in the occupied West Bank. Israeli human rights group Yesh Din has reported at least 170 settler attacks since September 27.

entries.title: Deepfakes, bots and distrust: How AI is shaping Israel's election
entries.snippet: For the first time, AI is playing a major role in Israel's elections. Observers warn that deepfakes, bots and influence campaigns could sway voters.

entries.title: Germany news: Berlin conference seeks to drum up investment
entries.snippet: The "Invest in Germany Summit" is set to kick off in Berlin as the government looks to fill gaps in public funding. DW has more.

entries.title: India news: CJP alleges 'deliberate' delay in leaders' release
entries.snippet: CJP leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were due to be released on Sunday. The judge in the case has recused himself after claiming that he was threatened. DW has more.

entries.title: Brazil: Lula, Bolsonaro clash in heated presidential debate
entries.snippet: The candidates traded barbs, including over Bolsonaro's ties to US President Donald Trump in their first debate, days before the October 25 election runoff.

entries.title: Emmanuel Macron slams 'failures' over protest unrest in France but refuses his interior minister's resignation
entries.snippet: France's president has refused the resignation of his interior minister, who says police "lost control" during protests that turned violent at the weekend. France's PM has called for limited curfews around the country.

entries.title: What Earth's sixth mass extinction event means for humans
entries.snippet: Human activity is driving plants and animals to extinction at an unprecedented rate. As countries meet in Armenia to discuss ways to reverse nature loss, DW reveals how declining biodiversity is already harming people.

entries.title: Austrian Airlines flight from Tel Aviv makes emergency landing after bomb threat
entries.snippet: An Austrian Airlines flight from Tel Aviv to Vienna made an emergency landing in Bulgaria after a bomb threat was reported near the Bulgarian-Romanian border. A MiG-29 fighter jet escorted the plane.

entries.title: Trump defends Russia sanctions waivers, accuses Zelenskyy of 'prolonging war'
entries.snippet: The US president again accused his Ukrainian counterpart Volodymyr Zelenskyy of not wanting to end the war. The remarks come amid renewed tensions over US policy toward Moscow, including waiving some sanctions.

entries.title: Canada: Fire at Alberta military Base kills four, leaves 19 in critical condition
entries.snippet: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney says a "serious incident" sparked a major fire at on Alberta military base. Four people have died, 39 are in hospital and at least 19 are in critical condition.

entries.title: Ebola: Kenya cases rise to 8, spreads to 8th Congo province
entries.snippet: A senior health official in Kenya said there have now been eight Ebola infections in the country, while in DR Congo the disease has spread to an eighth province.

entries.title: Albania's Prime Minister Edi Rama ignores calls to resign amid violent clashes
entries.snippet: Anti-government protesters continued calls for Edi Rama to step down as violent clashes between demonstrators and police persisted.
